text: Changes to the public API or the SDK interfaces are mine to decide.
Housekeeping in our own repos (formatting, lint fixes, patch-level dependency bumps, deleting merged branches): just do it.
Anything that spends more than $100 a month, or commits us to a contract, comes to me.
Anything customers will see (emails, docs, changelogs, announcements) comes to me before it goes out.
Never delete or merge customer data without asking me.
Access and security changes are always mine.
Flaky tests get fixed, or quarantined with a ticket. Never just delete a test.
Accept routine internal meeting invites; just do it.
Anything about a person (hiring, reviews, feedback) stays with me.
If a task runs past twice its time budget, stop and check in with me.
Never push to main; work on a branch with a preview.
Travel: book the cheapest reasonable option.
